strengths.finding: The refinement works through posing and composition, with unchanged geometry, short reach and the full performance catalog. The compact body, attached stub feet, four layered wings and unequal antennae remain coherent in the current whole-catalog sheet.
strengths.basis: Byte-identical character.js; motion diff; numeric anatomy tests; geometry.json; all-current.png and matched day/night hand sheets.

strengths.finding: Thinking now gives the intentional chin mitten more visual priority because the quiet free hand sits lower and farther away. The right hand, head nod and foot tap were not altered. Focused also gains two more distinct low hands. This is a useful contact clarification rather than a longer arm or a new anatomical solution.
strengths.basis: motion.js changes around thinking/focused; hands-day/night.png and sizes-thinking.png.

strengths.finding: Grateful's clasp moves below the ruff and reads as two joined lower lobes with a central contact seam in the larger matched renders. It has not become two disconnected hands. Worried retains an upper/lower diagonal relation and Shy retains a quieter near-separated gather, although their small-size distinction is still modest.
strengths.basis: hands-day/night.png; sizes-grateful.png, sizes-worried.png and sizes-shy.png; unchanged 48-unit reach and original mitten paths.

strengths.finding: The signature hand is more distinctly outward and cupped than the old tucked acknowledgment. In the inspected 2350–2720ms frames the hand rises and turns once after the head/gaze return, then holds; the free hand does not compete. The original consideration hold and shared investigation/wry opening remain.
strengths.basis: offer-sequence-day/night.png; sizes-curious-investigate.png; new meaningful monotonic offer/hold assertions and the motion diff.

strengths.finding: The phone correction is attached to the actual heading direction and preserves the causal ordering. Only five head/gaze channels are remapped, with original posing restored by 2350ms before the offer. The current 320/390px samples are more upright and directed above than their lateral baseline; the desktop near-horizontal composition remains nearly unchanged.
strengths.basis: staging.js measureDirection/mapPose; baseline/current attention PNGs; 108 browser cases; original-curious and exact-return checks.

strengths.finding: Staging follows the clip's clock, caches DOM layout outside character frames, preserves the displayed correction on replay, freezes paused/inspected frames on resize, and reuses the displayed pose across theme changes. It adds no independent tween to reduced-motion or paused states.
strengths.basis: Full staging.js/signature.js and controller tests; browser-checks.json replay/resize/reduced records. This supports controlled local behavior, not a general production-performance claim.

deductions.finding: The former purely screen-right phone behavior is corrected in source and rendered samples, but this is a small shift of the existing eye forms and head pose. The glasses remain a strong cue, so a static frame still does not unequivocally identify the heading as the thought's subject. That is a remaining staging-specificity limit, not evidence of a faulty bearing calculation.
deductions.resolutionStatus: Prior literal directional mismatch materially addressed; unprimed semantic reading is still untested.

deductions.kind: validation limit, not a reproduced bug
deductions.finding: I have not observed continuous normal-speed playback of the new wrist turn, dynamic resize/retarget, replay or the complete updated foundation. Tests and selected PNGs do not establish whether the 36-degree offer turn feels like a soft presentation or an unintended flick, nor prove all intermediate contacts. There is no fresh physical-device or attributed rendering trace for the new staging controller.
deductions.resolutionStatus: Retain the temporal/device limit. Prior desktop callback numbers are historical evidence and do not measure this new controller. No source optimization or retiming is justified by uncertainty alone.

improvementCriteria: Observe the current 1900–3050ms visitor return and offering turn continuously at normal speed and slowed playback. Retune only if a reproduced flick, extra pulse or contact pop is visible; retain the quiet free hand and stable hold.

For minimum-size expressive use, compare Grateful/Shy/Worried/Thinking and the invitation without their emotion labels at the intended rendered size. Improve posing or allocate more display area only when a matched comparison demonstrates a gain; preserve the original hand shapes, 48-unit reach and required chin/clasp contact.

Observe the full phone sequence in the real composition to distinguish a heading-directed glance from generic upward attention. Preserve the exact authored visitor return rather than holding the look upward through the offer.

Before website performance claims, trace active animation and resize/replay in the final integration on intended physical hardware. Retain separate source, frame, callback, perception and audience evidence; do not treat the deterministic 30fps film as a runtime benchmark.

workflowChanges: Carry prior deductions forward explicitly and mark each as resolved, partly improved or still unverified. Keep the overall same-lens score instead of scoring only the successful patch.
Pair a same-time before/after image with actual-size day/night sheets and the complete relevant hand/attention sequence; preserve intentional contact rather than applying separation indiscriminately.
Test the composition correction as an addition to the engine: current displayed pose on replay, paused resize freeze, exact visitor return, theme parity and no independent reduced-motion clock.
Keep rendering and perception evidence separate. Use source/tests to establish bounds and continuity, actual frames to inspect contact, and continuous/device evidence for feel and runtime claims.
rulesNotApplicableWithReason: UI timing limits do not compress the intentional multi-second performance or the 380ms staging handoff. Controls must remain responsive; requested acting is content.
Transform/opacity-only guidance does not justify changing expressive SVG anatomy or removing required contact. Existing path deformation is retained; measure an actual cost before optimization.
Intentional Thinking chin contact and Grateful clasp should not be separated merely to remove every overlapping contour. Clarity must preserve the acted relation.
Keyboard activation of Play remains equivalent access to the character performance; it is not an unnecessary animated keyboard-interface response.
Static reduced-motion poses are valid here. No added fade, bounce or stagger is required for compliance with a general motion recipe.

No new full skill read was needed: the already reviewed animation skills directly cover this lens. Design-taste marketing-page prescriptions do not govern this character/contact refinement; no new site design is being implemented.
